mechanics: Existing same trial/audit/commit/endpoint loop and unchanged force/work/tangent/inertia/scientific gates. Explicit resource duration840 forwarded only under new exact string mode, one persistent owner with no restoration/segments/deadline renewal. No FD replay.

recording.stage_record: canonical complete ORIGINAL returned stage row plus LF: unknown42, complete StageEvaluation including all signed R/I/J/M/pose/vm/am and derivatives/maps, actual context/predecessor/epoch. Original evaluation called once and unchanged returned object forwarded.
recording.references: Raw unissued_stages holds step,record_index,zero-based offset_bytes,length_bytes,sha256; length/SHA include LF. Seek/read/hash/JSON parse each record independently; no dropped observation or max/global scalar replacement. Journal hash covers concatenation of complete records.
recording.write_policy: Append/flush each original stage exactly once. Separate append-only complete initial/endpoint event journal: initial at actual_initial_signed_balance, each actual endpoint before development gates and again only after passing gates, with distinct event/step/status, full original row/state/work/accounting/candidate, criteria/scales and available initial model/M/provenance. Existing save labels dispatch these events; no physical-loop change. Overwrite bounded scalar progress only. Full raw once with exclusive xb in finally completion/firstfailure.
recording.final_fields: Journal path,format,offset convention,max pertrial/total,record count/bytes/concatenated SHA; full initial and every actual committed endpoint with original counts distinguishing committed and gate-passing controls.
recording.prospective_failure: First solve, scientific, resource or evidence-I/O failure stops before next trial; original failures remain NONPASS. A solver commit failing later gate is retained and is not engineering admission.
recording.endpoint_references: Each event uses canonical JSON plus LF. Raw endpoint_journal.records references event/step/offset/length/SHA including LF; final bytecount,recordcount,concatenated complete-records SHA. Initial plus at most2*192 endpoints, maximum385events. BEFORE-gate record remains unassessed on failure; after-gate record exists only for actual passing gates.
recording.recovery: Hard external kill may prevent final raw and can leave a partial final record in either journal. Recover only complete valid JSONL records. Progress is best-effort: truncation/write can leave empty/partial JSON. No guaranteed readable progress or power-loss durability claim. Journals preserve complete original records once flushed; incomplete tail is never an admitted state.

scope: N192-only finite-angle gate control; final each cell attitude>=.2rad is coverage, not temporal/spatial accuracy or C7/public qualification. Future N32/64 or macro/refinement/resource authority is not inferred.
